BREAKING: Starlink is getting closer to launching in Iraq. 🇮🇶

Iraq's Communications and Media Commission says the final legal and technical steps are now underway before the service goes live.

The country approved Starlink's operating license earlier this month after years of discussions with SpaceX.

Once launched, Starlink is expected to bring high-speed internet to remote and underserved communities across Iraq.

Another country is joining Starlink's growing global network.

NEURALINK JUST MADE A MAJOR SURGERY BREAKTHROUGH
Neuralink has updated its surgical procedure and completely removed a key step.
Instead of removing the dura (the tough protective membrane around the brain), the implant threads now go directly through the dura without needing to take it out.
This change makes the surgery:
•  Less invasive
•  Faster
•  Safer
•  Much easier to scale to more patients

Video

Neuralink has solved through-dura electrode implantation!

This is a very big deal, as it greatly improves the safety and ease of interfacing with the brain.
